story.title: Skyroot Aerospace Raises $60M, Becomes India's First Spacetech Unicorn Ahead of Vikram-1 Launch
story.summary: Hyderabad-based Skyroot Aerospace has raised $60 million in fresh funding, becoming India's first spacetech unicorn at a valuation crossing $1 billion. The capital will be used to support commercial launch operations of the Vikram-1 rocket, which is preparing for its inaugural orbital flight from Sriharikota. The milestone signals a maturing private space sector in India backed by policy reform and investor confidence.
